readings: Count each inventory record as one physical film copy. For each rating, count the copies in inventory and compute the arithmetic mean of those counts across ratings. Return one row containing the total copy count for ratings above that mean and the arithmetic mean of those ratings’ count differences from it, without rounding.

Count each distinct film title represented in inventory once per rating. Compute the arithmetic mean of those title counts across ratings. Return one row containing the total distinct title count for ratings above that mean and the arithmetic mean of those ratings’ count differences from it, without rounding.
queries:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS mean_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.copy_count) AS total_copy_count,
  AVG(rc.copy_count - rm.mean_count) AS mean_count_difference
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm
WHERE rc.copy_count > rm.mean_count

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.title) AS title_count
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
mean_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(title_count) AS value
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.title_count) AS total_distinct_title_count,
  AVG(rc.title_count - mc.value) AS mean_count_difference
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN mean_count AS mc
WHERE rc.title_count > mc.value
